result.instructions: Tools for Lago, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lago data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lago_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lago_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lago_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lago_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lago_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers in Lago, paginated. Lago API: GET /customers.

tools.name: lago_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Retrieve a single customer by external id. Lago API: GET /customers/{external_customer_id}.

external_customer_id.description: The customer external unique identifier (from your application).

tools.name: lago_get_customer_current_usage
tools.title: Get customer current usage
tools.description: Retrieve a customer's usage-based billing data for the current period. Lago API: GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/current_usage.

apply_taxes.description: Whether taxes should be applied. Defaults to true.

tools.name: lago_get_customer_past_usage
tools.title: Get customer past usage
tools.description: Retrieve a customer's usage-based billing data for past periods. Lago API: GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/past_usage.

periods_count.description: Number of past billing periods to return.

billable_metric_code.description: Filter usage to a specific billable metric code.

tools.name: lago_list_customer_subscriptions
tools.title: List customer subscriptions
tools.description: List a customer's subscriptions. Lago API: GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/subscriptions.

tools.name: lago_get_customer_portal_url
tools.title: Get customer portal URL
tools.description: Get a customer's billing portal URL. Lago API: GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/portal_url.

tools.name: lago_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, optionally filtered by customer, plan, or status. Lago API: GET /subscriptions.

status.description: Filter by a single status: active | pending | canceled | terminated. Default active.

tools.name: lago_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Retrieve a single subscription by external id. Lago API: GET /subscriptions/{external_id}.

tools.name: lago_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List billing plans, paginated. Lago API: GET /plans.

tools.name: lago_get_plan
tools.title: Get plan
tools.description: Retrieve a single plan by code. Lago API: GET /plans/{code}.

tools.name: lago_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by customer, status, payment status, or issuing date. Lago API: GET /invoices.

status.description: Filter by a single status: draft | finalized | failed | pending | voided.

payment_status.description: Filter by a single payment status: pending | failed | succeeded.

issuing_date_from.description: Filter invoices issued on/after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

issuing_date_to.description: Filter invoices issued on/before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: lago_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice by its Lago id. Lago API: GET /invoices/{lago_id}.

tools.name: lago_list_billable_metrics
tools.title: List billable metrics
tools.description: List billable metrics, paginated. Lago API: GET /billable_metrics.

tools.name: lago_get_billable_metric
tools.title: Get billable metric
tools.description: Retrieve a single billable metric by code. Lago API: GET /billable_metrics/{code}.

tools.name: lago_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List coupons, paginated. Lago API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: lago_list_add_ons
tools.title: List add-ons
tools.description: List add-ons, paginated. Lago API: GET /add_ons.

tools.name: lago_list_wallets
tools.title: List wallets
tools.description: List a customer's prepaid credit wallets. Lago API: GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/wallets.

tools.name: lago_list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes
tools.description: List credit notes, optionally filtered by customer. Lago API: GET /credit_notes.

tools.name: lago_get_credit_note
tools.title: Get credit note
tools.description: Retrieve a single credit note by its Lago id. Lago API: GET /credit_notes/{lago_id}.

tools.name: lago_list_fees
tools.title: List fees
tools.description: List fees, optionally filtered by customer, subscription, or fee type. Lago API: GET /fees.

fee_type.description: Filter by fee type: charge | add_on | subscription | credit | commitment.

tools.name: lago_analytics_gross_revenue
tools.title: Analytics: gross revenue
tools.description: Monthly gross revenue (finalized invoice payments + advance fees, net of tax/discounts). Lago API: GET /analytics/gross_revenue.

external_customer_id.description: Filter revenue at the customer level.

tools.name: lago_analytics_mrr
tools.title: Analytics: MRR
tools.description: Monthly recurring revenue (MRR) from subscription fees. Lago API: GET /analytics/mrr.

tools.name: lago_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Creates a customer in Lago (additive). Lago API: POST /customers with body { "customer": { ... } }.

external_id.description: The customer external unique identifier (required, provided by your application).

metadata.description: Structured metadata to attach to the customer (Lago expects an array of {key, value, display_in_invoice?} objects).

display_in_invoice.description: Show this pair on the customer's invoices.

tools.name: lago_create_event
tools.title: Create usage event
tools.description: Records a usage/metering event in Lago. This WILL be counted toward the customer's usage and affects billing. Idempotent via transaction_id. Lago API: POST /events with body { "event": { ... } }.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the event — the idempotency key (required).

code.description: The billable metric code this event targets (required).

external_subscription_id.description: The subscription external id to link the event to (required).

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (or ISO); defaults to event reception time.

properties.description: Additional event properties used to compute the fee (required for sum/max/unique aggregations).

precise_total_amount_cents.description: Precise total amount in cents, used by the dynamic pricing model.
